findings.comment: Site is zoned MF-2 and located immediately adjacent to an SF-3 triggering property, making it subject to current Article 10 Compatibility Standards (LDC §§ 25-2-1051–25-2-1063, eff. July 15, 2024). Height limits of 40 feet within 50 feet of triggering property per § 25-2-1061 should apply. However, the site plan does not acknowledge or demonstrate compliance with Article 10; the application form states 'Subject to Compatibility Standards? No,' and no compatibility assessment appears on the cover sheet or site plan sheets.

applicableAreas: cover sheet and site plan sheets
findings.comment: Site plan does not include compatibility notes specifying which LDC sections apply per current Article 10. Notes must reference Ordinance 20240516-004 (eff. July 15, 2024) and identify applicable height limits, buffer/setback requirements, screening requirements, and noise limits per § 25-2-1063. Notes referencing the repealed § 25-2-1067 or old distance tiers are not compliant with current code.

Site plan does not document whether an Article 10 exception under § 25-2-1052 applies. The site does not qualify for any documented exemptions (site is not CBD/DMU, is not a structural alteration, and is multifamily residential, not a qualifying use type). Applicant must clarify whether an exception is claimed or confirm applicability of Article 10.

Multifamily residential project with 39 units must be within one-half mile walking distance of a public transit route per § 25-1-703(B)(4). Site plan and supplementary documents do not include documentation of transit route proximity or evidence of an approved director waiver (which may be granted in high opportunity areas, when transit plans are available, for LIHTC projects, or for fair housing purposes).

Site is within a Nonconforming Signs Ordinance area per § 25-10-152. While the site plan includes a general note requiring compliance with Chapter 25-10, it does not specifically address or demonstrate compliance with the Nonconforming Signs Ordinance requirements. Specific nonconforming signs area compliance must be documented on the site plan.
